INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  MINUTES – February 24, 2021

The Inglewood Library Board met on February 24, 2021 via Zoom. The meeting was called to order at 5:00 p.m. by
Board Member Julie Minton.

Roll Call

Present:
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member
Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy to the City Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Board Member Minton made a motion for the approval of the minutes for January 27, 2021.

  All the Board Members approved the minutes.

Library Report

  Deputy to the City Manager, Harjinder Singh gave the board members update of the library’s new Sirsi
  system that went live on February 4. Mr. Singh walk them through our new system, compared with the old
  Polaris system, talked about

    Format, usability, accessibility, Hoopla, Cloud Library

    Digital library card that gives an instant access to all of our digital material

    Soon will be moving to overdrive, they've got integration for their magazines as well all in one area.
  And all these book licenses that we pay from Cloud Library we can just bring them to overdrive.

    Process of ordering book
  1
     Added a new section to make suggestions for purchases

    Staff will continue working from home until April 2, which means we are not going to have curbside
  services and are going to have only electronic resources
  Board Member Minton and Cochran asked questions regarding our new system and Mr. Singh answered
them.

Public Comments

  None

Friends Report
  Susan Carleo, President of the Friends of Inglewood Public Library (FOIPL) informed the board that friend’s
bookstore is now totally located in the outer lobby of the library. The second thing is that FOIPL instituted a hands
free payment method, so that people will be able to drop their funds, donations into the collection bin. And after
opening the library, they will start talking about other ways to get a clientele back to our book sales. Mrs. Carleo
also talked about Amazon Smile as a charity that people can connect to. So, when you shop on Amazon, sign up
and designate FOIPL as your preferred charity, any purchase that is eligible, 0.5% of the amount goes to Friends of
Inglewood Public Library.

  Deputy to the City Manager, Harjinder Singh added that Amazon smile is on the monthly newsletter and is
going to be permanent fixture of the monthly newsletter to remind people on constant basis that is available and it
would help a lot if more people will use it to make their purchases. Mr. Singh also talked about having direct
donations and things of that nature on the monthly newsletter where if somebody wants to make a donation directly
through Venmo or something like that they can do that as well.

Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

  All Board members thanked Mr. Singh and library staff for all the hard work that’s been done on upgrading
the website, simplifying of ordering of books and moving our library into another level. All Board members were very
happy.

  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh thanked everyone.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 5:58 p.m.
